title: spec/lang/_generic/boundaries.json: how the matcher splits text into words
description: One shared table for every language (slice 50 section 5, slice 14). `default` applies to every base; an entry keyed by a full tag (zh-Hant) or a primary language (fr) overrides it key by key. A language needs an entry only when the default visibly fails for it.

default.description: Every key is required here (the tests check this), so a base without an entry still has a complete set.

spaces.description: false for languages written without spaces between words (ja, zh, th): a phrase may continue across an empty gap.

join.description: Joiners that merge two words with exactly one of them between (well-known, can't, a soft hyphen). invisible is always on.

possessive_suffix.description: A suffix after an apostrophe that stays outside the swap (English 's).

possessive_whole_after.description: Words after which the suffix is a contraction, so the token matches only whole (it's, let's).

elision_prefixes.description: Prefixes ending in an apostrophe that split off and are never swapped (French l'eau).

keep_whole.description: Words with an elision-like apostrophe that are never split (aujourd'hui).

trailing_apostrophe_words.description: Words whose final apostrophe is part of the word (Italian po').

sentence_openers.description: Characters that start a sentence besides the usual ones (Spanish ¿ ¡).

fold.description: width: halfwidth and fullwidth forms match their usual forms (ｺｰﾋｰ, ｄｏｇ).

lower_locale.description: Lowercase keys with the language's own rules (Turkish İ and I).
